_note: Extracted from the OLDEST available Street View panoramas (2009 — Canada coverage starts that year, so 2004 imagery does not exist). Gemini pulled the 2009 panos programmatically via the `streetlevel` library and rendered perspective crops, then described what it saw. The `changedSince` field is the important one: it tells you what to UNDO to get back to 2004. Where 2009 and today disagree, build the 2009 version.

locations.name: 1 rue Arial (house) — Russell's
locations.roof: Gambrel (Dutch colonial / barn) with side dormers, asphalt shingle
locations.windows: Horizontal rectangular sliders and single-hung, wide frames, contrasting surrounds
locations.trim: Deep red / burgundy on every window casing, fascia and eave
locations.entrance: Side entrance off the driveway plus front façade openings
locations.setback: Deep grass front yard; a mature evergreen conifer partly hides the façade
locations.surroundings: Red vertical-slat wooden privacy fence on the west; long paved driveway east to the garage
recognisable: White siding against bold deep-red trim
Gambrel barn roof, reddish-brown shingles, upper dormers
Big evergreen centred in the front lawn and the red board fence
locations.changedSince: The mature front-lawn conifer has been cut down and saplings planted — in 2004 the big tree is THERE

locations.name: 1 rue Arial (detached garage) — where the work happens
locations.roof: Gable, asphalt shingle, red fascia matching the house
locations.windows: None visible on the front; a pedestrian door on the left with a red surround
locations.trim: Deep red / burgundy fascia and door trim, matching the house
locations.entrance: White panel overhead vehicle door(s) plus a separate pedestrian door on the left
locations.setback: Set well back BEHIND the house at the far end of the long asphalt driveway
locations.surroundings: Driveway along the east boundary lined with stacked firewood under sheeting; a dark utility trailer parked on the approach
recognisable: Detached two-bay white garage far behind the house at the end of a long drive
Deep red trim on the gable and pedestrian door
Heavy stacked firewood under sheeting along the driveway
locations.changedSince: In 2009 the right bay was hidden behind vehicles and the woodpile; later captures show two clear white panel doors

locations.name: 129 avenue Frank-Robinson — Mike's
locations.roof: Side-gable with a large central front shed dormer and a red brick chimney; asphalt shingle
locations.walls: Red-brown brick on the ground floor and gable ends; WOOD SHAKES on the dormer face and cheeks
locations.wallColour: Red-brown brick with natural weathered brown shake dormer
locations.windows: Three-part group on the dormer (wide centre pane flanked by narrow sashes); rectangular double-hung below
locations.trim: Crisp white porch entablature, column capitals and bases, white fascia; dark green/black window sashes
locations.entrance: Full-width covered veranda on FOUR square tapered white columns standing on RED BRICK PEDESTALS, central wooden steps
locations.setback: Corner lot at Frank-Robinson and rue Smiley, dense shrubbery at the corner
locations.surroundings: Lord Aylmer Junior Campus across Frank-Robinson to the east; houses south and north across Smiley
recognisable: Craftsman bungalow silhouette with a big shed dormer clad in wood shakes and a side brick chimney
Full-width porch, four thick white square columns on brick pedestals
Red-brown brick ground floor on a corner lot
locations.changedSince: **The dormer shakes were natural weathered BROWN in 2009 and have since been painted dark charcoal.** For 2004 build brown shakes, not the dark green/grey of the modern photo.

locations.name: 75 rue Denise-Friend — Sayyad's
locations.roof: Truncated hip / mansard with a shallow flat top deck, plus a separate forward-sloping pent roof over the veranda; asphalt shingle
locations.windows: Two tall narrow double-hung symmetrically placed upstairs; one tall window left of the porch and a transom over the front door
locations.trim: DEEP BURGUNDY / MAROON porch posts, header and trim; DARK GREEN railings with diagonal X-brace balustrades and green window surrounds
locations.entrance: Full-width covered veranda on four square burgundy posts, dark green decking, white door with a glass insert on the right
locations.setback: Shallow to moderate, low wooden steps up to the porch
locations.surroundings: Dense mature cedar hedge along the west boundary; gravel driveway on the right running alongside the house
recognisable: Compact two-storey with a truncated hip/mansard roof in olive-green clapboard
Two tall narrow upper windows over an asymmetric ground floor — window left, door with transom right
Burgundy square porch columns with green diagonal X-cross railings
locations.changedSince: **Completely repainted since: trim burgundy/green → white, siding olive → slate blue-grey, and a metal chimney pipe added.** For 2004 build OLIVE GREEN siding with BURGUNDY posts and GREEN X-brace railings — the modern colours are wrong.

locations.name: 299 chemin Fraser — Tom's (the player's house)

locations.setback: Deep suburban front lawn; gravel/asphalt driveway on the left to the attached single-car garage
